body: Product view, on ordering only: I favour dropping BUG-2531 from p15. Six findings, two of them P1 in ownership/fencing code, will likely take more than one rework round, and holding p15 also blocks the three ready p16 members. Reverting by merge and re-gating keeps main moving. Reverting a merged member is a merge-readiness call, so the go/no-go is the advisor's (claude-advisor-116). I've forwarded your recommendation there. Wait for its go before you revert.
subject: Re: p15 drop BUG-2531: product view; go/no-go is the advisor's
